name: Hero: Vol. #1
source:
A superhero action-thriller about a mysterious being who gains supernatural abilities after a freak accident and who fights to bring down a business tycoon bent on world domination.

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Category:Hero]Choices Wikia[/url]]

Vol. #2 has been officially cancelled in 2021.
translation:
这是一部超级英雄题材的动作惊悚故事。一名神秘人物在一场离奇意外后获得了超能力，并为打倒一位妄图统治世界的商业巨头而战。

[摘自[url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Category:Hero]Choices Wikia[/url]]

官方已于2021年宣布取消第二卷。
